explanations.text: One of us is doing it

shelve.note: Needs one explanation still standing. The next incident plays the variant that breaks it, and it is crossed out for good.

keep.note: Write it down unexplained. The next lead page (L1, L2, ...) is revealed nearby; the next incident plays as written.

breaks.house: The sounds come from the shelf, not the walls
breaks.us: Every friend's door is shut and you hear all four breathing
breaks.wild: The forest is silent; nothing is outside

breaks.house: Only the rabbit smells; the wood smells of cedar
breaks.us: Jamie recoils for real; he did not plant it
breaks.wild: The rabbit is dry; nothing crawled in
breaks.me: The smell stays on your fingers (ch 3)

breaks.house: The bear is warm, the bed is cold
breaks.us: Everyone was at the creek with you
breaks.wild: It has a heartbeat; nothing is inside

breaks.house: It is outside, on a low branch near the cabin (ch 5); nothing about an old house reaches a tree
Three taps, a count; a house does not count
breaks.us: All four friends are in the hall with you
breaks.wild: The drag is on the ceiling, inside
breaks.me: The giggle is recorded on Jamie's phone (added)

breaks.house: The toys' seams are tighter than yesterday
breaks.us: The animals were emptied, not cut
breaks.wild: "emptied, like something had taken what it needed"
breaks.me: Marcus covers them; he sees them too

breaks.house: Toys and pegs moved, in a locked room
breaks.me: The pegs match no one's last turn on the scoresheet
